welcome.title: Welcome to TalentAI 👋
welcome.description: Let's walk you through the platform in about a minute. We'll cover every feature so you can start hiring smarter right away.

dashboard.title: Dashboard 📊
dashboard.description:
Your home base. At a glance you can see:

• Active Job Posts & Campaigns
• Total Applicants across all posts
• Interview activity over the last 30 days
• Applications Over Time & per Job Post charts
• Top-performing job posts by candidate score

posts.title: Job Posts
posts.description:
Create and manage your open positions here.

• Hit '+ New Job Post' to launch the creation wizard
• Choose manual entry or let the AI generate the post for you
• Draft posts can be resumed any time from where you left off
• Once live, edit is disabled once candidates have passed interview

applications.title: Applications
applications.description:
Every candidate who applied across all your posts lands here.

• Filter by name, skill, or specific job post
• See CV score, current status, and applied date at a glance
• Click any card to open the full candidate profile and take action

employees.title: Employees
employees.description:
Manage your team members and internal users.

• Invite employees by email and assign them roles
• Set permissions: Admin, Manager, or Viewer
• Employees get their own dashboard to track assigned candidates
• Remove or update roles at any time

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description:
Automate your hiring pipeline end-to-end.

• Create a campaign to bundle a job post with an interview flow
• Set automatic invite emails, reminders, and deadlines
• Track completion rates and candidate progress in real time

departments.title: Departments & Employees
departments.description:
Organise your company structure.

• Create departments and assign team members
• Members can access their own interview dashboards
• Useful for multi-team hiring across the organisation

settings_info.title: Settings — Company Info
settings_info.description:
Keep your company profile complete and up-to-date.

• Company name, email, industry and size
• Required experience level for posted roles
• A complete profile builds trust with candidates browsing your listings

settings_contact.title: Settings — Contact & Presence
settings_contact.description:
Tell candidates where you are and how to find you.

• Country / location and employment type (Remote, On-site, Hybrid)
• LinkedIn company page and website URL
• These appear on your public company profile

settings_api.title: Settings — API Keys
settings_api.description:
Integrate TalentAI with your own tools and services.

• Create a key with a name, service identifier, and permission scopes
• Set a rate limit (requests per second) and an expiry date
• Toggle keys on/off or regenerate them at any time
• The plain key is shown only once at creation — copy it immediately

chat.title: Messaging 💬
chat.description:
Chat directly with candidates.

New message notifications appear here as candidates respond to interview invites or reach out directly.

notifications.title: Notifications 🔔
notifications.description:
All important events appear here:

• Interview completions and scores
• New applications on your posts
• Pipeline status changes
• System alerts and reminders

Click 'View all notifications' to see the full history.

finish.title: You're all set! 🎉
finish.description:
That covers everything on TalentAI. You can replay this tour any time by clicking the Help button in Settings.

Good luck with your hiring!
